messages:
mira (sec): FYI — starting next maintenance window (48h), we will enforce S3 bucket public-access-block and default server-side encryption (SSE-S3) for all buckets owned by redwood-* accounts. This is a policy change after an audit found 7 buckets with public ACLs or missing encryption. Action: owners must verify workloads that rely on public read ACLs or client-side unencrypted uploads.

infra-bot: Scan summary: 7 noncompliant buckets detected: redwood-artifacts, redwood-model-checkpoints, experiments-uploads. Issues: publicACL (4), encryptionMissing (5). Full report: https://internal.redwood/sec/s3-scans/2450012345

mira (sec): The enforcement will be applied by terraform-managed aws_resource and an S3 Block Public Access policy plus a bucket-lifecycle lambda that applies SSE if missing. If a service needs an allowed exception (eg. customer demo site), request a timeboxed exception.

jon (sre): Heads-up: CI jobs that upload artifacts using boto3 without specifying ServerSideEncryption will fail after enforcement. Please patch uploads to include: ServerSideEncryption='AES256' or use kms key 'alias/redwood-e2e'. Examples in docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/storage/sse-guides

claire (data): Our ingestion pipeline writes to experiments-uploads from an external partner. That partner currently PUTs objects with no encryption. We'll need to coordinate; can we add a presigned-post workaround?

mira (sec): Presigned URLs are fine if the PUT includes required headers. If partner can't change client, request an exception and we'll set up an ingress proxy to re-encrypt on ingest. Exceptions are temporary and require mitigation plan.

leo (ml-platform): Model checkpoint downloader in ml-runner expects public read on redwood-model-checkpoints for nightly retrain. I'll update the runner to use signed URLs and add SSE headers. Est ETA: 36h.

jon (sre): Ops action: I'll kick off a dry-run apply in staging tonight and post the terraform diff. If anything breaks we can roll the change back quickly.

infra-bot: Exception request form: https://internal.redwood/sec-requests/new. Required: bucket name, owner, reason, TTL, mitigation steps. Approvals: Sec + SRE lead. Max TTL: 14 days.

mira (sec): Critical note: any customer-data buckets must use KMS keys (alias/redwood-customer) not SSE-S3. If you have customer data in plaintext, treat this as high priority. We may suspend access for noncompliant buckets after enforcement.

claire (data): Acknowledged. I'll inventory datasets and flag any that contain PII. Posting list in ~2h.

leo (ml-platform): Ack. I'll open PRs to update upload libs and CI templates.

jon (sre): Ack. Will monitor S3 error metrics during rollout and watch for 403s from CI accounts. Alerting: s3.upload_errors > 10/min triggers pager.

mira (sec): Thanks team. Please reply here with ack when you have scheduled changes or submitted an exception. This helps us track progress before enforcement window. :lock: 

claire (data): Ack — inventory started, will update thread.

leo (ml-platform): Ack — PRs in progress.

jon (sre): Ack — staging dry-run started, ticket SRE-3245.
